steps.en: Install and configure language and embedding providers in a persistent runtime home
steps.zh: 在持久运行目录安装，配置语言和嵌入模型

steps.en: Create a course library from your textbook
steps.zh: 从教材创建课程知识库

steps.en: Parse and index the material, retaining indexing status
steps.zh: 解析并索引材料，保留索引状态

steps.en: Ask a course question with retrieval enabled for that library
steps.zh: 对所选知识库启用检索，提出课程问题

steps.en: Run bounded model/tool rounds and retain tool evidence
steps.zh: 运行有界模型／工具轮次，保留工具证据

steps.en: Return the answer and any collected source references for review
steps.zh: 返回回答和收集到的来源，供你核验

value.en: Your course materials and a traceable tool-assisted explanation share one study workflow
value.zh: 课程材料和可追溯的工具辅助解释共用学习流程
